tagline: Plays a chord of a chosen type from each incoming note
description: Builds a chord on every incoming note using a fixed chord type and voicing, and releases the whole chord when the note is released. Use it to play full chords from single keys or to turn a bass line into a chord part. Built as a MIDI effect, so Ableton Live will not load it; use a host that accepts third-party MIDI effects.

features.name: 18 chord types
features.description: Triads, sus2/sus4, sixths, sevenths (including dim7 and m7b5) and add9/ninth chords.

features.name: Voicings
features.description: Root position, 1st to 3rd inversion, Spread, Drop-2 and Drop-3.

features.name: Octave shift
features.description: Moves the chord from 2 octaves down to 2 octaves up from the played note.

features.name: Strum
features.description: Offsets each chord note after the first by a set amount; the 0 to 100 value is applied in samples, so the spread is at most a few milliseconds.

features.name: Velocity
features.description: Uses the played velocity or a fixed velocity from 1 to 127.
